messages:
lee: staging->prod promo blocked: deploy-bot stuck on cache prefetch with 504s. change window open ~18m.
kevin: I see it. attempts keep backing off (6/10). artifact present in registry only cache prefetch failing.
deploy-bot: automated: promo-30021 triggered by lee at 1717901234. state=PREFETCH_RETRY attempts=6 last_error=504.
sam-oncall: checking cache-service. s3-proxy threads stuck, queue growing. spinning one proxy node now.
kevin: options: wait for infra fix, abort, or manual promote with pin+--skip-cache-prefetch. we tested skip-prefetch on staging.
nora: prefer manual promote so change window isn't wasted. require immediate smoke + canary 2% for 30m and rollback doc.
lee: agree. kevin, run manual promote and update release notes.
deploy-bot: manual promote requested: `deploy-bot promote --env prod --image-sha sha256:77aabbcc --skip-cache-prefetch --tag manual-skip-2026-03-21`
kevin: kicked job promo-30022. monitoring e2e and smoke.
deploy-bot: success: promo-30022 completed. prod image=sha256:77aabbcc. tag=manual-skip-2026-03-21.
lee: starting smoke checks and canary routing. watching p95 and 5xx.
sam-oncall: after restart, 504 rate dropped 20%->1.7% over 2m. opening incident INC-2026-03-cache-21 for postmortem (suspect proxy leak).
nora: release note added: "Manual promotion due to cache prefetch 504s. Promoted sha256:77aabbcc; prefetch skipped. Canary 2% for 30m. Rollback target: sha256:99887766."
kevin: rollback playbook added to release doc. follow-ups: add circuit-breaker fallback to deploy-bot prefetch, doc `--skip-cache-prefetch`.
lee: pinning to release doc and closing promo hold. monitoring window in progress. :white_check_mark:
